title: drosera nitidula var. allantostigma
intro: Drosera nitidula var. allantostigma, commonly known as Sundew, is a species of carnivorous plant that obtains essential nutrients by capturing and digesting insects. The Sundew has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Sundew include its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm the nervous system, and provide immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Sundew include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
